source_first_method: Read original published workbook cells and raw OOXML independently before loading either model JSON for comparison. Existing derived totals were not used as source-extraction operands.
scope: Fin whale group 4 original XLSX basic fields, all 37 fleet-discard cells, landings missingness, sheet metadata and source-to-canonical-to-saved-runtime comparison. No paper/DOCX interpretation claim is made here.

basic_caption: Basic input parameters of the Mediterranean marine ecosystem model for the 1990s period. O=Other; f.=fish; NC=Non commercial; OC=Other commercial.
source_extraction.discards_caption: Discards (t/km²) by gear type for the Western, Adriatic, Ionian and Eastern areas of the Mediterranean marine ecosystem model (1990s period)
source_extraction.catches_caption: Landings  (t/km²) by gear type for the Western, Adriatic, Ionian and Eastern areas of the Mediterranean marine ecosystem model (1990s period)
source_extraction.fin_whale_landings_status: No group4/Fin whale column is present; missing, not a published zero.

source_only_arithmetic.interpretation_condition: The catch/production ratio assumes the source fleet densities share the baseline biomass area denominator and represent the annual Ecopath time step. The workbook caption alone does not establish those two details.

unit_and_scope_qualification.discard_caption_exact: Discards (t/km²) by gear type for the Western, Adriatic, Ionian and Eastern areas of the Mediterranean marine ecosystem model (1990s period)
unit_and_scope_qualification.assessment: Workbook labels density by region-specific fleets but provides no different area denominator or area weights. Do not turn repeated published numeric values into duplicate rows or infer a corrected scaling without independent source evidence. Main paper/DOCX context must settle common-area/annual interpretation.

findings.bounded_conclusion: The audited original and pooled group 4 fields and all 37 fleet-discard literals reproduce the published XLSX exactly; saved runtime staging uses the published sum and explicitly assumes missing landings zero. No source-backed numerical correction is established by this XLSX audit.
findings.remaining_source_interpretation: Annual/common-area interpretation and biological source consistency remain separate from transcription fidelity.
findings.repeated_regional_values: The three 0.0000144 gillnet and three 0.000072 driftnet entries are already separate region-labeled rows in the published workbook; no deduplication is supported.
